faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our platform and services.

questions.question: What types of digital assets do you offer?
questions.answer: We offer a wide range of digital assets including Excel macros, Python automation scripts, data processing tools, API integrations, and complete business software solutions. All assets are professionally developed, tested, and verified before publication.

questions.question: How does licensing work?
questions.answer: Each purchase includes a commercial license for the number of users specified in your plan. You get lifetime access to the purchased asset, including all future updates. Enterprise plans offer custom licensing options including white-label rights and unlimited user licenses.

questions.question: Can I get a refund if the product doesn't work for me?
questions.answer: Yes! We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee on all purchases. If you're not satisfied with any product, contact our support team within 30 days for a full refund, no questions asked.

questions.question: Do you provide technical support?
questions.answer: Absolutely. All plans include technical support. Starter plans get email support with 24-48 hour response times. Professional plans get priority 24/7 support. Enterprise plans include dedicated account managers and SLA guarantees.

questions.question: Are the scripts and software secure?
questions.answer: Security is our top priority. All code is reviewed by our security team, follows industry best practices, and includes no malicious code or backdoors. We also provide regular security updates and maintain compliance with industry standards.

questions.question: Can I request custom development or modifications?
questions.answer: Yes! Professional and Enterprise plans include access to custom development services. We can modify existing assets or create completely custom solutions tailored to your specific business needs.

questions.question: How often are products updated?
questions.answer: Products are updated regularly based on user feedback, bug fixes, and new feature additions. Starter plans receive monthly updates, Professional plans get weekly updates, and Enterprise customers can request priority updates as needed.

questions.question: What programming languages and platforms do you support?
questions.answer: We primarily focus on Excel VBA, Python, and JavaScript for automation. Our products support Windows, macOS, and Linux environments. We also offer cloud-based solutions that work across all platforms.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: Terms and conditions governing the use of the CELAEST platform, AI Mesh orchestration, and digital asset acquisitions.
terms.description: Master service agreement for the CELAEST platform, AI Mesh infrastructure, and digital assets.

sections.title: Subject Matter and Scope of Service
sections.summary: CELAEST provides an enterprise AI Mesh orchestration platform, workflows, and verified digital asset marketplace.
paragraphs: These Terms of Service govern your access to and use of the web platform, APIs, and associated services provided by CELAEST Inc. ("the Platform"). By registering, accessing, or using our services, you ("Customer" or "User") agree to be legally bound by these terms.
If accessing the Platform on behalf of a corporation or entity, you represent and warrant that you possess the requisite legal authority to bind said entity to this master agreement.

sections.title: Corporate Accounts and Credential Security
sections.summary: Credentials are for corporate use only. Organizations bear full responsibility for the confidentiality of access tokens and keys.
paragraphs: Access requires creation of an authenticated corporate account. Users must provide accurate, current, and complete information. Login credentials and API tokens generated are strictly confidential and non-transferable outside authorized personnel.

Customer assumes full responsibility for all operations executed under its credentials. In the event of suspected security breaches or unauthorized access, Customer must notify security@celaest.com immediately.

sections.title: AI Mesh Orchestration and Data Sovereignty
sections.summary: We process AI under 3 transparent modalities with commercial Zero-Training guarantees. You retain 100% ownership of your outputs.
paragraphs: CELAEST provides resilient connectivity and orchestration across frontier models under three clearly demarcated technical frameworks:

Ownership of Prompts and Outputs: As between CELAEST and Customer, Customer is the exclusive owner of all intellectual property rights in input data (prompts, files) and generated outputs (code, analytics, workflows). CELAEST claims no ownership over outputs produced through platform use.
points: Cloud Mesh Mode (Starter & Pro Plans): Processing is conducted via commercial B2B APIs under binding zero-training agreements. Prompts and inferences are transient and never train foundational public models.
BYOK Mode (Bring Your Own Key): Customer connects direct corporate API keys (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Vertex), operating under their direct contractual terms with those providers.

On-Premise / Sovereign Mode (Enterprise): Models and infrastructure deployed 100% within Customer's private network or dedicated cloud, guaranteeing physical and logical air-gapping without internet egress.

sections.title: Asset Marketplace, Macros, and Scripts
sections.summary: Asset purchases grant an internal commercial license. Public redistribution, reselling, or open-source publication is strictly prohibited.
paragraphs: Digital assets distributed across the Marketplace (Excel macros, Python scripts, autonomous connectors, and specialized tools) undergo strict pre-publication verification.

Acquisition grants a non-exclusive, perpetual, non-transferable commercial license for internal operational implementation within Customer's organization. Reselling, sublicensing, or posting source code to public repositories is strictly prohibited.

sections.title: Pricing, Billing, and 30-Day Money-Back Guarantee
sections.summary: Transparent pricing without hidden fees. All plans include an unconditional 30-day money-back guarantee.
paragraphs: Services are billed on a periodic subscription basis (monthly or annually) or per-asset purchase in accordance with posted rates. Billing is processed in local currency or USD.

Money-Back Guarantee: All new subscription plans include an unconditional 30-day money-back guarantee. If the platform does not meet expectations within the first 30 days, contact support@celaest.com for a full refund.

sections.title: Service Level Agreement (SLA) and Availability
sections.summary: 99.9% uptime commitment on Pro plans and financially backed custom SLAs on Enterprise tiers.
paragraphs: CELAEST maintains resilient multi-region infrastructure designed to provide a minimum monthly uptime of 99.9% for core services.
For Enterprise customers, dedicated Service Level Agreements (SLAs) apply with contractual remedies, financial service credits, and 24/7 prioritized engineering support.

sections.title: Limitation of Liability and Indemnification
sections.summary: Exclusion of consequential damages or lost profits. Total aggregate liability capped at fees paid over the preceding 12 months.
paragraphs: To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, CELAEST shall not be liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages, lost profits, or data corruption resulting from executing scripts on Customer's databases or local systems.

CELAEST's total aggregate liability arising out of or related to these terms shall be strictly limited to the total fees actually paid by Customer during the twelve (12) months preceding the incident.

sections.title: Modifications, Governing Law, and Dispute Resolution
sections.summary: 30-day advance notice for material changes. Friendly dispute resolution and binding commercial arbitration.
paragraphs: We reserve the right to modify these Terms. In the event of material changes, Customer will receive at least thirty (30) days advance notice via email or prominent dashboard notification.
Any dispute shall initially be submitted to 30 days of good-faith negotiations, and if unresolved, to binding commercial arbitration.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy & AI Mesh
privacy.subtitle: Uncompromising commitment to enterprise data sovereignty, Zero-Training AI policy, and international compliance standards.
privacy.description: How we manage, isolate, and safeguard your enterprise data and AI workloads.

sections.title: Data Controller and Core Principles
sections.summary: CELAEST Inc. acts as data controller and custodian under strict minimization, confidentiality, and legitimate purpose principles.
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy governs the processing of personal and corporate data collected through the CELAEST platform. We comply with leading global privacy frameworks including the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA).
Data Protection Officer (DPO) Contact: For compliance inquiries, contact privacy@celaest.com or our central legal office.

sections.title: Data Collected and Purpose of Processing
sections.summary: We only collect data strictly necessary to authenticate, bill, and execute requested automation workflows.
paragraphs: We collect two primary categories of information:
Purpose: Information is utilized exclusively to maintain accounts, process billing, monitor network health, and execute requested AI workflows.
points: Account & Billing Data: Corporate name, institutional email, organization ID, and payment tokens processed by PCI-DSS Level 1 certified gateways.
Technical Data & Telemetry: IP addresses, session identifiers, DDoS mitigation logs, and latency metrics processed on an aggregate basis.
Workload Data (Prompts and Parameters): Transient data processed in active memory during inference.

sections.title: Strict Zero-Training AI Policy
sections.summary: Binding commitment: Your prompts, source code, and enterprise files are NEVER used to train or fine-tune public models.
paragraphs: CELAEST maintains an unyielding Workload Confidentiality principle: zero data submitted for execution or inference across our AI Mesh is ever utilized to train, fine-tune, or improve public foundational models.
Unlike free consumer tools, our integrations operate exclusively over commercial B2B APIs that legally mandate zero retention for model training.

sections.title: Infrastructure and Service Subprocessors
sections.summary: We work exclusively with SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certified global cloud providers under DPAs.
paragraphs: To provide high availability and ultra-low latency, we partner with world-class subprocessors governed by Data Processing Addenda (DPAs):
Each subprocessor is audited technically and contractually to enforce EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs).
points: Cloudflare Inc. (Edge security, WAF firewalls, DDoS mitigation, and TLS 1.3 certificates)
Vercel Inc. (Edge application hosting and globally distributed CDN)
Anthropic PBC / OpenAI LLC / Google Vertex AI (Commercial AI inference under Zero-Training terms)
Render / AWS (Microservices infrastructure and isolated relational databases)
Stripe Inc. (PCI-DSS Level 1 encrypted payment processing)

sections.title: Technical Security, Isolation, and Encryption
sections.summary: TLS 1.3 encryption in transit, AES-256 at rest, and strict multi-tenant database isolation.
paragraphs: We apply defense-in-depth across all system tiers. External and internal network traffic is encrypted using TLS 1.3 with Perfect Forward Secrecy (PFS). Data at rest is secured via AES-256 encryption.
Multi-Tenant Isolation: Each organization is logically segregated with cryptographic barriers preventing cross-tenant data leakage.

sections.title: Your Privacy Rights (GDPR, CCPA, and Global Frameworks)
sections.summary: You hold the unconditional right to access, export, rectify, or permanently delete all your data at any time.
paragraphs: You retain sovereign control over your information at all times. We provide free and unimpeded exercise of your rights:
To exercise these rights, submit a signed request to privacy@celaest.com. We respond formally within fifteen (15) business days.
points: Right to Access and Portability: Request an export of all data associated with your organization.
Right to Rectification: Correct inaccurate or outdated account records.
Right to Erasure ("Right to be Forgotten"): Irreversible removal of credentials, accounts, and associated records across active databases.
Right to Restriction: Restrict specific processing activities upon request.

license.subtitle: Legal terms and intellectual property rights governing purchased Excel macros, Python scripts, and automations.
license.description: Commercial licensing terms, modification rights, and operational restrictions for Marketplace assets.

sections.title: Commercial License Grant
sections.summary: Perpetual, worldwide, non-exclusive commercial license for internal operational use within Customer's organization.
paragraphs: Upon purchasing or downloading macros, scripts, or software from the CELAEST Marketplace, Customer is granted a perpetual, worldwide, non-exclusive, non-transferable commercial license to execute the asset within its internal operations.
License scope covers all internal workstations, servers, and authorized personnel up to the licensed tier volume.

sections.title: Use Restrictions and Anti-Piracy Protection
sections.summary: Public distribution, reselling, sublicensing, or posting source code to external third parties is strictly prohibited.
paragraphs: The granted license expressly prohibits:
Breach of these restrictions results in immediate revocation of the license without refund and authorizes legal remedies.
points: Selling, reselling, renting, leasing, sublicensing, or transferring asset source code to external third parties.
Posting source code to public repositories (GitHub, GitLab, forums) or open-access internet venues.
Bundling Marketplace scripts or macros into a competing commercial product or service.

sections.title: Modifications and Derivative Works for Internal Use
sections.summary: Full freedom to audit, adapt, and refactor code to integrate seamlessly into your company's workflows.
paragraphs: Customer is granted full rights to audit, inspect, adapt, refactor, and integrate purchased source code with existing internal systems.
All derivative adaptations remain subject to the non-redistribution and confidentiality restrictions set forth herein.

sections.title: Quality Verification and Sandbox Testing
sections.summary: Assets undergo rigorous verification, but must be validated in staging environments prior to production rollout.
paragraphs: Every Marketplace asset undergoes technical vetting before publication. However, because client IT topologies vary infinitely, software is delivered "as is".
Customer is strictly responsible for validating and testing all scripts in staging or sandbox environments prior to production deployment.

cookies.title: Cookie & Tracking Policy
cookies.subtitle: Transparent disclosure of essential technical cookies, session preferences, and anonymous aggregated telemetry.
cookies.description: Technical details regarding local storage and cookies utilized on the CELAEST platform.

sections.title: What are Cookies and Local Storage
sections.summary: Technical identifiers required to maintain secure authentication, CSRF defense, and interface preferences.
paragraphs: Cookies are small text files stored in your browser to maintain state during visits. CELAEST utilizes cookies exclusively for security, operational integrity, and user preference persistence.
We enforce a strict Zero Third-Party Advertising policy: we do not sell telemetry to data brokers or employ cross-site ad trackers.

sections.title: Categories of Cookies Utilized
sections.summary: We only deploy strictly essential technical cookies and aggregated performance telemetry.
paragraphs: We group our cookies into two distinct categories:
points: Essential Technical Cookies: Mandatory for secure authentication, CSRF mitigation, CDN load balancing, and active session tokens.
Preference Cookies: Retain your language selection (Spanish / English) and interface theme settings across sessions.
Aggregated Telemetry (Plausible / First-party): Measures page load latency in an aggregated, non-PII manner without persistent tracking.

sections.title: Browser Management and Opt-Out
sections.summary: You hold complete control to clear or block cookies directly from your browser settings.
paragraphs: You can configure your browser to reject or notify you about cookie storage. Please note that disabling essential technical cookies may prevent logging into your account or accessing the management dashboard.
To manage cookies in Chrome, Safari, Edge, or Firefox, navigate to your browser's Privacy & Security settings.
